composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Show Shinobu Kocho with her familiar gathered dark hair, purple ends, and compact butterfly hair ornament. Dress her in a modest light outer layer over a dark high-neck top. She offers a small low wave, with an attentive smile and relaxed eyebrows. Use clean cel shading and broad lilac background shapes, including one soft green plane that merely suggests an outdoor setting. Keep both eyes unobstructed and the ornament contained within the circular crop. The expression is gentle and conversational. Simplify the garment pattern so the face remains the dominant readable shape. Both visible irises contain a clear red Sharingan design with three small black comma marks and a normal dark pupil; keep bright catchlights and the friendly expression. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
